notes: Endpoints: the spec is committed as fragments of the paths object (api/v4/source/*.yaml, assembled by the repo's own build), unioned here into 608 operations under /api/v4, plus the routes only the code has, read in it (channel join requests, property field options, the /api/v4/{anything} 404 catch-all, the web package's OAuth routes: 24). Scope server/channels/api4/ and server/channels/web/oauth.go (where /oauth/intune and the OAuth metadata live). Every API route is registered on a gorilla subrouter kept in a struct field built in api.go — api.BaseRoutes.Users = api.BaseRoutes.APIRoot.PathPrefix("/users").Subrouter(), APIRoot = Router.PathPrefix(model.APIURLSuffix) — and used from another file: api.BaseRoutes.Users.Handle("/known", h).Methods(http.MethodGet). Until H2b item 2 step 2 (2026-10-16) the prefix never came out and the roots Handle("", ...) were dropped (prefix-other-file, all 607). GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, registered as MainRouter.PathPrefix(model.OAuthMetadataEndpoint).Handler(h).Methods(GET), was missed until H2b item 4 (2026-10-16) (path-prefix-handler): a PathPrefix with a method is one endpoint. The e2e webhook test server (e2e-tests/cypress) registers routes outside test patterns (test-app-folder). Calls (sample only): the webapp and e2e helpers call `${Client4.getBaseRoute()}/...`, whose /api/v4 lives in the client class (prefix-in-client-wrapper) or in a route helper (url-from-helper); url.JoinPath(serverURL, "version") keeps the variable base as a placeholder (url-object-builder). CI scripts and external services are right. The webapp itself calls through Client4 (doFetch with this.getXRoute()), not measured. Since H2 Phase 5 (2026-10-17): e2e-tests/, cypress/ and playwright/ are test code (as e2e/ already was), so the webhook test server and the e2e helpers' calls left the run and the sample — 2 routes judged wrong and 9 calls (7 judged right as HTTP, 2 wrong) — none of them in the expected lists.
